title: Lunar Prospector - Global Hydrogen Abundances (Lawrence et al., 2022)
description: Global hydrogen abundance map in calibrated ppm, derived from Lunar Prospector Neutron Spectrometer epithermal count rates (Lawrence et al., 2022, JGR Planets, doi:10.1029/2022JE007197). Built on the Wilson et al. 2018 pixon-reconstructed epithermal map, with a rare-earth-element (REE) absorption correction and Apollo sample calibration applied to convert count rates to absolute ppm. Authors: D. J. Lawrence, P. N. Peplowski, J. T. Wilson, R. C. Elphic.
